title: Gnomeregan
body: Gnomeregan was the capital of the gnomes, a city of workshops and machine halls beneath the western hills of Dun Morogh, lost when troggs broke in from below and the purge meant to stop them poisoned it. Mekgineer Thermaplugg now rules what is left from its lowest halls. The gnomes who stayed are leprous, so clouded by the sickness that they still fight the invasion, cutting down every stranger as a trogg. Irradiated troggs swarm the halls, and the city's machines still patrol.

parts.body: Blastmaster Emi Shortfuse still believes the city can be retaken if the invasion is stopped. She blasted shut the tunnels where the troggs were breaking in from below.

title: The Holdouts' Room
body: In the middle of the ruined city one room still holds out against the madness outside it. A band of gnome holdouts keeps it, warriors, medics and technicians who stand with the exiles in Ironforge, and an engineer sells supplies there, though business has not been good. Against the walls stand gnomish Sparklematic machines that scrub the grime from any valuable for a few coins.

title: Mekgineer Thermaplugg
body: Sicco Thermaplugg was once High Tinker Mekkatorque's trusted friend and chief advisor. Now he holds the deepest chamber of Gnomeregan as his own, calls those who come for it usurpers, and to the exiles in Ironforge he is the traitor who doomed their city. The goblins of Orgrimmar know him for something else: beside him stands a safe holding the plans of a new gnomish rig, and only he knows its combination.

parts.body: The blueprints reached Orgrimmar, and the goblin Nogg means to make every gnomish innovation in the rig a goblin innovation for his new shredders.
